request.style: English, jazz, solo female contralto voice, upright bass, piano, brushed drums, double bass, moody and reflective, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
One day Jacob was cooking stew
Esau came in exhausted from the field
Quick let me gulp down that red stuff
So he was called Edom in the heat
Sell me your birthright Jacob said
Look I am about to die he replied
Swear it to me here and now
So he sold his birthright away

[Chorus]
This is nothing less than the house of God
This is the gate of heaven open wide
Angels go up and down on the stair
The Lord stands above in the night

[Verse]
I am Esau your firstborn he lied
The voice is Jacob but hands are Esau
Bring me wine and eat my son
May God give you dew of heaven
Abundance of grain and new wine
Peoples will serve you nations bow
Cursed be those who curse you
Blessed be those who bless you now

[Chorus]
This is nothing less than the house of God
This is the gate of heaven open wide
Angels go up and down on the stair
The Lord stands above in the night

[Verse]
Jacob woke up and said surely
The Lord is in this place I did not know
How awesome is this holy ground
This is the gate of heaven
I will not let you go unless
You bless me before the daybreak comes
What is your name the man asked
Jacob answered and the name changed

[Chorus]
This is nothing less than the house of God
This is the gate of heaven open wide
Angels go up and down on the stair
The Lord stands above in the night

[Outro]
Gather around and listen sons
I will tell you what will come
Israel your father speaks
In the days to come
